name: BRu Wizard Chess
description:
Okay, I love the idea and have been wanting to make a personal chess game... I love that like wizard chess it will be animated and fun. I want the current UI to be more organized into the perfect "Match Setup". I want this to be something that is shown and asks user for input, before you can start playing. Here is what I want the user to be able to choose. The setting chosen will determine:
1. what each player's pieces look like, sound like
2. Their attack animation along with weapons will change
etc....
3. the boards appearance

Here is what the "Match Setup" will ask:

1. White or Black (which color are you playing)
2. Playing against AI or another player? (2 players play on same screen on same device, the view will switch each time to accommodate)
3. If AI is your opponent, what difficulty do you want it set: easy, normal, hard, intense
4. The name of user's Army (Ex. BRuLand, My Country, etc.)
5. Option to name user's own Queen and King
6. I want the user to be able to choose an army type, and I guess use well known historical options to choose from. This is only to determine how the user's pieces are "dressed", how they are geared up and type of weapons they use.
7. So in a 2 player game, both sides have a turn to decide all these things, and customize their army before beginning. Currently no change to the rules of the game. Every piece moves the same as always.
8. Make sure that 2 player mode can be played from the same device and it looks cool.
9. Pick a "Battleground" basically a board layout they can choose
